scope: source only for a new policy-communication hypothesis, no market outcomes or strategy signals
listing_evidence: https://www.cbr.ru/dkp/mp_dec/ first key-rate-release tab uses NewsList 84035; continuation URLs observed in markup
selection: all key-rate release records in the dedicated category with publication dates2018-2025; include extraordinary decisions, no selection by rate action/text or market outcome
stop: first listing page with a publication earlier than2018; require strictly descending page boundary, unique release URLs and exact first-page recheck
article_identity: headline and header publication date plus exact footer clock must match the source listing; no future article fetch
availability: 23:59:59 Moscow of the printed publication date, current-vintage development assumption; original bytes and revisions not proved
future_policy_years_in_text: pre2026 releases may discuss later forecast years; these are known forecasts, not protected2026 market outcomes
attribution_required: Press Service of the Bank of Russia, https://www.cbr.ru/
